replicate_statements: The data are presented as mean ± SD.
Statistical analysis involved Student's t‐test and one‐way ANOVA followed by post hoc Tukey's HSD (honestly significant difference) test.
outputs.explanation: A quantification bar graph with error bars (mean ± SD) is shown, and 'N=4' is given (only next to the mitochondrial fraction graph), so the number of replicates is reported, but the caption/panel never states what the n=4 units are (e.g., four mice per genotype, four independent blots, four technical replicates), so the replicate type is not specified.

Immunoelectron microscopy images are shown as representative fields from 'control mice,' but no number of animals, sections, or fields examined is given anywhere in the caption, so neither the number nor type of replicates underlying this representative panel can be determined.

A single western blot is shown comparing HMGB1 across purification methods; the caption describes the methods used for each lane but never states how many times this experiment was repeated or how many independent samples/animals were used, so replicate number and type are not reported.

A single western blot from the proteinase K protection assay is shown without any statement of the number of independent experiments, animals, or samples used, so no replicate count or type is reported.
